exercises.name: Bodyweight squat

rules.limitation: Reference geometry is not independent expert form ground truth.

rules.summary: Stance and knee spacing are monitored against the chosen demonstration.

rules.limitation: Width ratio is a spacing proxy; it cannot establish knee-over-toe tracking, foot rotation or ground pressure.

rules.summary: Breathing, pain, muscle activation, resistance/load and exact contact require information beyond this pose stream.
